+++ b/test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+---
+- name: create upgrade requirements
+  copy:
+    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml'
+    content: |
+      collections:
+        - name: namespace1.name1
+          version: '<1.1.0'
+        - name: child_dep.child_dep2
+          version: '<1.2.4'
+
+- name: install older collection for upgrade test
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:0.1.0 -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections' -s galaxy_ng
+
+- name: install older dependency collection for upgrade test
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install child_dep.child_dep2:1.2.2 -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections' -s galaxy_ng
+
+- name: upgrade collection from requirements file
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections' -s galaxy_ng
+  register: upgraded_collection
+
+- name: check upgraded version
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/namespace1/name1/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_manifest
+
+- name: check second upgraded version
+  slurp:
+    path: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections/ansible_collections/child_dep/child_dep2/MANIFEST.json'
+  register: upgraded_dependency_manifest
+
+- name: check upgrade result
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - '"Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.0.9'' to" in upgraded_collection.stdout'
+      - '"Installing ''child_dep.child_dep2:1.2.3'' to" in upgraded_collection.stdout'
+      - (upgraded_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.0.9'
+      - (upgraded_dependency_manifest.content | b64decode | from_json).collection_info.version == '1.2.3'
+
+- name: rerun upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade-requirements.yml' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections' -s galaxy_ng
+  register: repeated_upgrade
+
+- name: check upgrade idempotency
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - '"Installing ''namespace1.name1" not in repeated_upgrade.stdout'
+      - '"Installing ''child_dep.child_dep2" not in repeated_upgrade.stdout'
+
+- name: opt in to prerelease upgrade
+  command: ansible-galaxy collection install --upgrade --pre namespace1.name1 -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections' -s galaxy_ng
+  register: prerelease_upgrade
+
+- name: check prerelease upgrade
+  assert:
+    that:
+      - '"Installing ''namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1'' to" in prerelease_upgrade.stdout'

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('upgrade,pre,no_deps,dep_floor,expected', [
+    (False, False, False, '2.0.0', []),
+    (True, False, False, '2.0.0', [('parent.main', '2.0.0'), ('child.dep', '2.0.0')]),
+    (True, True, False, '2.0.0', [('parent.main', '2.1.0-beta.1'), ('child.dep', '2.0.0')]),
+    (True, False, False, '1.0.0', [('parent.main', '2.0.0')]),
+    (True, False, True, '2.0.0', [('parent.main', '2.0.0')]),
+])
+def test_upgrade_resolves_installed_collections(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path,
+                                                upgrade, pre, no_deps, dep_floor, expected):
+    versions = {
+        'parent.main': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0', '2.1.0-beta.1', '3.0.0'],
+        'child.dep': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+    }
+    dependencies = {
+        ('parent.main', '1.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=1.0.0'},
+        ('parent.main', '2.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=' + dep_floor},
+        ('parent.main', '2.1.0-beta.1'): {'child.dep': '>=' + dep_floor},
+        ('parent.main', '3.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=2.0.0'},
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions',
+                        lambda namespace, name: versions[namespace + '.' + name])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None,
+                            dependencies.get((namespace + '.' + name, version), {})))
+    installed = [Candidate('parent.main', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('child.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections', lambda *args: installed)
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', mock_install)
+    art_mgr = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(art_mgr, 'get_direct_collection_dependencies',
+                        lambda candidate: dependencies.get((candidate.fqcn, candidate.ver), {}))
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.main', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    def run():
+        collection.install_collections(requirements, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server],
+                                       False, no_deps, False, False, pre, art_mgr, upgrade=upgrade)
+
+    run()
+    assert {(call[0][0].fqcn, call[0][0].ver) for call in mock_install.call_args_list} == set(expected)
+    if upgrade:
+        installed[:] = [Candidate(name, version, None, 'dir') for name, version in expected]
+        if 'child.dep' not in [name for name, version in expected]:
+            installed.append(Candidate('child.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'))
+        mock_install.reset_mock()
+        run()
+        mock_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_upgrade_outdated_constraint_fails(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', lambda *args: ['1.0.0'])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections',
+                        lambda *args: [Candidate('parent.main', '3.0.0', None, 'dir')])
+    art_mgr = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    req = [Requirement('parent.main', '>=2.0.0,<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+    with pytest.raises(AnsibleError, match='Could not satisfy the following requirements'):
+        collection.install_collections(req, to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server],
+                                       False, True, False, False, False, art_mgr, upgrade=True)
+
+
+def test_upgrade_keeps_newer_installed_version(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions', lambda *args: ['1.0.0'])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections',
+                        lambda *args: [Candidate('parent.main', '2.0.0', None, 'dir')])
+    art_mgr = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(art_mgr, 'get_direct_collection_dependencies', lambda *args: {})
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', mock_install)
+
+    collection.install_collections([Requirement('parent.main', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')],
+                                   to_text(tmp_path), [galaxy_server], False, False,
+                                   False, False, False, art_mgr, upgrade=True)
+    mock_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('flag', ['-U', '--upgrade'])
+def test_upgrade_requirements_file_cli(flag, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    requirements_file = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
+    requirements_file.write_text('collections:\n  - name: parent.main\n  - name: child.dep\n')
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_cli, 'install_collections', mock_install)
+
+    call_galaxy_cli(['install', flag, '-r', str(requirements_file),
+                     '-p', str(tmp_path / 'collections')])
+
+    assert mock_install.call_args[1]['upgrade'] is True
+    assert {req.fqcn for req in mock_install.call_args[0][0]} == {'parent.main', 'child.dep'}

+def test_upgrade_resolves_installed_collections(galaxy_server, monkeypatch, tmp_path,

+    versions = {

+        'child.dep': ['1.0.0', '2.0.0'],
+    }
+    dependencies = {
+        ('parent.main', '1.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=1.0.0'},
+        ('parent.main', '2.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=' + dep_floor},
+        ('parent.main', '2.1.0-beta.1'): {'child.dep': '>=' + dep_floor},
+        ('parent.main', '3.0.0'): {'child.dep': '>=2.0.0'},
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_versions',

+    monkeypatch.setattr(galaxy_server, 'get_collection_version_metadata',
+                        lambda namespace, name, version: api.CollectionVersionMetadata(
+                            namespace, name, version, None, None,
+                            dependencies.get((namespace + '.' + name, version), {})))
+    installed = [Candidate('parent.main', '1.0.0', None, 'dir'),
+                 Candidate('child.dep', '1.0.0', None, 'dir')]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'find_existing_collections', lambda *args: installed)
+    mock_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(collection, 'install', mock_install)
+    art_mgr = collection.concrete_artifact_manager.ConcreteArtifactsManager(
+        to_bytes(tmp_path), validate_certs=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(art_mgr, 'get_direct_collection_dependencies',
+                        lambda candidate: dependencies.get((candidate.fqcn, candidate.ver), {}))
+    requirements = [Requirement('parent.main', '<3.0.0', None, 'galaxy')]
+
+    def run():

+    run()
